== Biography ==
Issobell was born before 1643. She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-1084|John Glasgow]] and [[Porteous-912|Issobell Porteous]].

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1084]] is assessed at 52% (possible). Issobell’s 1643 Edinburgh child citation names John Glasgow and Issobell Porteous. John-1084’s 1616 generation fits a father in 1643 and provides a compatible Lothian candidate. The Edinburgh John/Issobell Porteous family is not yet tied to that childhood.

Possible identification of the named adult father with John-1084. Patoune and Porteous are not silently equated and the mothers remain separately assessed.

Next useful test: Use a marriage, residence or named relative to bridge the 1616 and 1643 accounts.

Source basis already held: [https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:X1YN-JHD “Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564–1950,” FamilySearch, entry for Issobell Glasgow, 1643 (https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:X1YN-JHD), naming John Glasgow and Issobell Porteous; cited on the child's profile.]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.


A possible identification concerns Isob Glasgow. The banns/marriage index records Isob Glasgow and James Coldwell/ on 17 April 1684 at Glasgow.<ref>Scotland’s People: Old Parish Registers — banns and marriages: OPR 644 / 1/230 / 285; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ record].</ref> The original parish register image has not been inspected. The combined index date does not by itself identify the precise event type. Isob Glasgow and James Coldwell have no proven compatible local/live identity. The identification remains uncertain.
